title: Review: Sesoris Multi-Purpose Container Collection
excerpt: A comprehensive review of Sesoris' latest container collection designed for various storage needs.
content: We are proud to present Sesoris' latest collection of multi-purpose containers. Designed based on customer feedback, this collection addresses various modern storage needs.
## Collection Overview
This collection consists of 5 different sizes (XS to XL) with 3 material options: food-grade plastic, borosilicate glass, and stainless steel. All available in timeless neutral colors.
## Material & Quality
Each container is made from premium materials. Our plastic is BPA-free and food-safe. Borosilicate glass withstands extreme temperatures (-4°F to 752°F). Grade 304 stainless steel is rust-resistant.
## Lid Design

The silicone lid features a 4-lock system that ensures an airtight, leak-proof seal. You can carry it in your bag without worrying about spills. The lid is also microwave-safe (except for stainless steel).
## Stackable Design
All sizes are designed to stack stably with one another. This saves up to 40% storage space compared to regular containers.
## The Right Size for Every Need

- XS (0.5L): Perfect for spices, sauces
- S (1.5L): Ideal for snacks, leftovers
- M (4.5L): Great for meal prep
- L (12L): For bulk storage
- XL (30L): Versatile storage box
## What Customers Say

"Finally, a container that truly doesn't leak!" - Ani, Jakarta
"The design is beautiful, I'm not embarrassed to put it on the dining table" - Budi, Yogyakarta
"Worth the price, it's been 2 years and still looks brand new" - Citra, Surabaya
## Price & Value
It's slightly more expensive than standard containers on the market, but the durability and functionality justify the cost. 2-year warranty for manufacturing defects.
## Care Tips
Wash with a soft sponge and avoid abrasive materials. For glass, it can go in the dishwasher. Make sure to dry the silicone lid thoroughly before storing.
## Verdict

Rating: 4.8/5
Sesoris' container collection is a worthwhile investment for kitchen organization. Thoughtful design, quality materials, and proven durability.
## Where to Buy
Available on the Sesoris website, Tokopedia, Shopee, and the Yogyakarta experience store. Free shipping for purchases over $30.
